scope: kan decision: keep (the decision's own model's choice; in riichi the tsumogiri) vs each legal ankan / kakan / daiminkan (`universal::kan_universal`); fitted on the single-kyoku data
fitted_on: single-kyoku games: teacher RLActor-225 vs tsumogiri x3 (60,000) and current suzume (kan_mode=1) vs tsumogiri x3 (15,000), teacher labels
split: md5(game) % 10: 0 test (report only), 1-2 valid (early stopping), 3-9 train
optimizer: schedulefree.RAdamScheduleFree lr 0.0025, other settings at library defaults (decoupled weight decay; eval-mode weights kept)

curve.rule: keep the eval-mode weights of the lowest valid CE over the whole run (improvement > 1e-5); train at least min_epochs; after that stop only when valid CE has been worse than the best so far by more than worse_tol for `patience` consecutive epochs; at most max_epochs
